verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source voice agent runtime is a fair question for a voice AI platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes telli as a hosted platform: an app-issued API key, webhooks, and an MCP server. Bringing your own SIP trunk or forwarding numbers connects your telephony to telli's hosted service; it does not let you run the runtime on your own infrastructure. Nothing in the pack mentions open-source code or self-hosted deployment.
